svg.text: Plugin compatibility and rewrite effort pull in opposite directions. Only one option preserves the ecosystem at acceptable risk.
ecosystem does not come with you.
C# host, extensions stay in Node
Consume Pi via its versioned RPC
Legitimate if the goal is a .NET
“Nearly full plugin compatibility” and “migrate to .NET” are mutually exclusive as stated — plugin compatibility is defined by an in-process JavaScript contract.
Option C preserves the whole ecosystem by keeping Pi's runtime and adding a .NET client. Option B is the only true “migration”, and it retains only ~59% of extensions.
